strengths: Proposes a novel approach to mitigate diversity collapse in SFT, addressing a well-recognized problem in LLM training.
Empirical results demonstrate substantial improvements in diversity metrics and reasoning benchmarks.
The method is simple, computationally efficient, and applicable at inference time without additional training.

Baseline comparisons (e.g., DS-R1-Distill-7B, OpenR1-Distill-7B) are not explicitly stated to be trained under equivalent conditions to P-SFT. This could affect the validity of the comparison.
The paper lacks detailed statistical analysis (e.g., p-values, confidence intervals) for most reported improvements, making it difficult to assess the significance of results.
